shellCommands.command: git diff && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -50 && cat package.json next.config.* 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head
cat lib/products.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx "app/products/[slug]/page.tsx"; ls __agent_eval__; head -c 0 __agent_eval__/run.mjs; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs; grep -ril "cacheComponents" . | head -20; ls 01-app/*/ | head -80

(npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s "localhost:3123/products/lamp?currency=EUR" | grep -oE 'Signal Shop collection|Brass lamp|Stone vase|EUR [0-9.]+|USD [0-9.]+|Loading[^<]*' | sort | uniq -c; echo ---; curl -s "localhost:3123/products/vase" | grep -oE 'Brass lamp|Stone vase|EUR [0-9.]+|USD [0-9.]+' | sort -u; echo ---; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' localhost:3123/products/nope; curl -s localhost:3123/products/nope | grep -o 'could not be found' | head -1; pkill -f "next start"; git status --short
